Craven & Quill

Your photos and privacy.

Updated 29 September 2026. This notice covers the storybook preview and launch list.

For customer enquiries or requests about your information, email cravenluke@gmail.com.

Who is responsible

Craven & Quill is operated by Luke Craven in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. We decide how information is used to provide this preview and manage the launch list.

Your free preview

You enter a first name, reading age, story choices and a photo. Your browser sends these to our website server and OpenAI's drawing service to create your character. This processing is necessary to provide the preview you request. Avoid surnames, addresses, school names or other private details in your story.

The website does not save your uploaded photo, first name, story text or generated picture in its database. They remain in your open browser page while you use it. OpenAI and our hosting providers may process and retain service data under their own security and retention policies. We do not promise immediate deletion from their systems.

The service is for adults. Only upload a photo of yourself, or someone whose permission you have. For a child, you must be their parent or guardian or have that person's permission. We do not use photos to identify people, target adverts or train our own AI model.

If you join the launch list

Only after you choose to join, we save your email, preferred book format and its displayed price, your confirmation of buying interest, the campaign code that brought you here, country supplied by our host, and a record of your email permission. We use your consent to email you when these storybooks are ready to order. A free preview does not require joining the list.

We keep launch-list information until launch or withdrawal of consent, and review whether it is still needed after 90 days. We may retain the minimum consent or suppression record necessary to honour your choice and resolve complaints. Joining does not place an order or charge you.

Every launch email will include your personal unsubscribe link. You can also request access, correction, deletion or withdrawal of consent through our published contact address.

Optional visit measurement

We ask before measuring your journey. If you allow it, we save a random visit identifier in session storage and record which steps you reach, broad country and campaign codes. This helps us find failures and assess ads. No photos, names, email addresses or story text are included in these measurement events. If you join the list with measurement allowed, we link your visit identifier to that signup to count conversions.

We remember your measurement choice in local storage. You can change it using “Measurement settings” on the home or preview page. Declining does not prevent a preview or signup. Site measurement and Meta advertising measurement have separate choices. Earlier consent to site-only measurement does not permit Meta tracking.

Optional Meta advertising measurement

If you choose “Allow site & Meta”, and our Meta connection is enabled, the Meta pixel measures page visits and successful signups to help us assess and deliver our ads. Meta receives connection information such as your IP address, browser details, page address and advertising/cookie identifiers. It may link these events to your Meta account. A random event receipt helps recognise repeated reports of the same signup. We do not include your photo, name, email address, story text or reading age in these events. Automatic form capture and advanced matching are disabled.

Choose “Site only” or “No thanks” to use the preview without Meta tracking. You can withdraw permission in Measurement settings; future events stop and we clear Meta cookies that this website can access. Withdrawal does not erase events already received by Meta. Meta’s processing, retention and international transfers are described in its privacy policy and cookies policy. We rely on your consent for this optional measurement.

Service providers and security

Our website uses OpenAI Sites and Cloudflare hosting and database services, and OpenAI for drawing. These services and the operator may process information outside the UK. We limit the information sent to what the requested feature needs. The website uses HTTPS; access to the launch list requires a private access token.

Our hosting services receive ordinary connection information, including IP addresses. We use limited technical information and daily drawing counts to protect the service against abuse and control costs, based on our legitimate interest in operating a reliable service.

Your choices

Depending on your circumstances, you can request access, correction, deletion, restriction or a portable copy of your information, object to processing based on legitimate interests, or withdraw consent. Withdrawal does not affect processing already carried out. UK visitors can raise a concern with the Information Commissioner's Office.

For provider details see OpenAI's privacy policy and Cloudflare's privacy policy.
